source_areas.description: Agent loop, assistant middleware, deterministic intelligence, shared models, configuration, session, cache, transcript, audit, validation, and steering.
Provider adapters and failover, static/local tools, Flyto2 Core tool bridge, tool registry, MCP client/server, and capability manifests.
SQLite and hybrid memory, compaction, summarization, blueprint feedback, prompt blocks, eval cases, mutation, scoring, regression detection, and reports.
Permissions, prompt policy and injection detection, redaction, encrypted vault, sandbox, Guardian hooks, coding-agent verification, and evidence handling.
Channel adapters and routing, Telegram operations, scheduling, extension manifests/loaders/hooks, telemetry, and operator integration surfaces.
Structured security finding schema, authorized-target safety policy, and Flyto2 Core workflow blueprints for supported vulnerability categories.
CLI and package metadata, environment contract, release/demo scripts, sandbox image, distribution metadata, and CI/security/publishing workflows.

feature_surfaces.title: Agent and Python API
feature_surfaces.description: Exposes provider-agnostic agent, configuration, chat, streaming, usage, permissions, protocols, and coding-agent contracts through the package facade.

feature_surfaces.title: CLI, HTTP, and MCP entrypoints
feature_surfaces.description: Provides interactive/chat/code/blueprint/prompt-lab/server commands and JSON-RPC MCP discovery/call behavior over STDIO.

feature_surfaces.title: Flyto2 Core tool execution
feature_surfaces.description: Discovers runtime Core tools, publishes capability/risk metadata, validates module parameters, dispatches recipes/modules, and records evidence with browser recovery.

feature_surfaces.title: Memory, blueprints, and prompt evaluation
feature_surfaces.description: Stores/searches/compacts sessions, learns reusable workflow blueprints, and evaluates prompt candidates with scoring, adversarial checks, and regression reports.

feature_surfaces.title: Permission and safety controls
feature_surfaces.description: Applies permission tiers, URL policy, injection detection, redaction, encrypted vault handling, Guardian hooks, sandbox limits, budgets, and evidence controls.

feature_surfaces.title: Channels, Telegram, and scheduling
feature_surfaces.description: Routes messages and files through Telegram, Slack, Discord, and webhooks, with Telegram confirmations/steering/jobs plus persistent scheduled agent tasks.

feature_surfaces.title: Authorized security test workflows
feature_surfaces.description: Transforms structured findings into guarded Flyto2 Core YAML test workflows for thirteen vulnerability categories while rejecting unsafe targets by default.

feature_surfaces.title: Complete source reference
feature_surfaces.description: Generates and drift-checks every package function/class/method, CLI option, static tool definition, environment read, and maintainer script.
